title: Harden autonomous publication executor
body:
## Summary

- Hardened publication preflight, change-set staging isolation, and command error handling.
- Added public-safe publication payload handling and idempotent publication result updates.
- Added regression coverage for isolated staging, dry-run safety, and temporary Git repository publication flow.

## Checks

- make validate-artifacts
- make security
- python3 -m pytest tests
- make check
